8|

11| the new rate on its next refill tick. Keep the change and its
12| rationale in the commit message, because the capacity summary links
13| stanza history when quotas are questioned.
14| 
15| ## Defaults
16| 
17| Tenants the file does not name get the conservative built-in default.

19| explicit stanzas, reviewed with the team tag owner.
